subject.title: feat(agents): guard raw ingress by conversation audience

question: After replacing the owner assertion with host-verifiable sender provenance, should raw Plugin SDK ingress immediately fail closed for callers without that provenance and remove the trusted public command export?
rationale: The security defect has a concrete repair, but the immediate compatibility break is an intentional public SDK policy choice that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Fix then adopt fail-closed
options.body: Add host-verifiable sender provenance, retain canonical route checks, and approve the immediate SDK break with upgrade proof.

options.title: Fix then stage migration
options.body: Add host-verifiable sender provenance but preserve the old public contract temporarily under a named deprecation window.

options.title: Pause this slice
options.body: Defer the ingress contract until maintainers choose a different canonical owner-admission artifact.

recommendation.title: Fix then adopt fail-closed
recommendation.body: Add host-verifiable sender provenance, retain canonical route checks, and approve the immediate SDK break with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the central ingress, agent-runtime, routing, and Discord voice behavior involved in this decision.
